audit_entries.title: Render text to images and recover it by OCR — rounds 1, 3, 7
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Correct information-preservation objection and rough model/CPU economics; reported small raster/OCR screens. No mature neural OCR codec or optimized renderer/residual architecture is evidenced. E1, E2, E8.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Round 1 reports image/pixel forms worse than zlib. Round 3 emphasizes symbolic geometry instead. A fair literal OCR test needs an injective representation or explicit correction stream, renderer/font and OCR bytes, exact reconstruction, and matched text/raster models and CPU. M1–M3 apply. The cheap screen reasonably lowers priority; it does not prove every visual predictor impossible.
audit_entries.combination_work: Geometry was combined with other features, but a trained OCR predictor plus correction coder was not jointly optimized. No per-idea thinking hours are documented.

audit_entries.title: Low-resolution glyph codewords plus ambiguity residuals — rounds 1, 7 proposals
audit_entries.rigor_applied: The idea file explains why blur transfers information into corrections. That is a valid constraint, not a measured optimum. E8.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: The earlier report groups low-resolution/pixel attempts without a recoverable separate ledger. Specify the glyph alphabet, collision classes, exact byte/case/Unicode escape, and learn a joint glyph/residual distribution. Compare its complete codelength against a symbolic class/residual codec at equal cost. Do not count discarded ambiguity as compression.
audit_entries.combination_work: Conceptual connection to shape classes exists; no recorded optimized glyph-plus-residual system. This remains a low-priority alternative, not a completed architecture rejection.

audit_entries.title: CNN or other spatial predictor over rendered decoded history — original idea variants
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Compute concerns were discussed; no explicit trained causal CNN result is identified. E8.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Geometry lookup and shape tables are not a CNN. Define deterministic rendering of past context, fixed causal crop/padding and output probabilities; compare a same-budget character CNN and random spatial encoding. Price render/startup cost and every output. A tiny pilot can evaluate whether spatial inductive bias pays before writing a large system.
audit_entries.combination_work: Listed as an alternative expert, not integrated with the transformer/final coder. No evidence of architecture or kernel optimization for this variant.

audit_entries.title: Glyph features and factorized character embeddings — rounds 1, 3; idea 2
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Multiple seeds and random/identity controls in round 3 were better than the initial 400-step screen. The tiny 256-byte embedding saving was recognized. E1, E2, E8.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Geometry residual gains were approximately 0.105–0.106%, versus random 0.080% and identity 0.072%; attributed incremental signal was about 0.0004 bpb. Test fixed glyph versus equal-rank random/learned projections with matched extra parameters; separately test an actually factorized embedding's stored size. M7 prevents claiming redundant glyph features add information.
audit_entries.combination_work: Geometry was tested alongside residual modeling and classical contexts. It was not extensively co-designed with the later learned word-relation/placement architecture.

audit_entries.title: Shape-class-first hierarchy and integer shape contexts — rounds 1, 3
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Explicit shape→character factorization and classical comparisons; partial model matching. E2, E8.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Geometry-context CM scored 1.853 bpb versus random 1.847 and handmade classes 1.842; shape-first 1.917 versus 1.889 baseline, with random shape-first 1.925. Those are particular class choices. Optimize class alphabet/count smoothing and residual distributions under actual class-table cost; compare with ordinary character n-grams in the same mixer and measure CPU.
audit_entries.combination_work: Hierarchical and residual versions were compared, but class design plus stronger learned syntax/word models was not jointly trained. Rejecting these layouts is supported; rejecting every useful character grouping is not.

audit_entries.title: Confidence-gated orthographic/glyph residual expert — rounds 1, 3, 7
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Valid causal mixture/logit correction equations; small residual screens. The full proposed feature set and learned gate have not been implemented together. E2, E8, E9.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Early hard-word/shape specialists and later fixed geometry boosts are substitutes for a learned context-dependent residual. Train a compact model using preceding spelling, prefix/suffix, parser state and baseline uncertainty, with all false alarms in normalized loss. Include identical-capacity generic-feature controls and final-bit supervision; freeze/export and confirm natively. A target's observed error cannot select its own gate.
audit_entries.combination_work: Proposal-level synthesis is substantial; tested joint learned orthography × syntax × uncertainty interactions are missing.

audit_entries.title: Feed additional classical-model predictions into the neural expert
audit_entries.rigor_applied: The idea file identifies existing signals as inexpensive candidate inputs. No comprehensive input-ablation study is recorded. E8, E17.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Mixing neural and CM outputs is not training the transformer on extra classical channels. Collect causal model distributions/states, specify their quantized interface, and compare PPMD-only, selected extra channels and equal-width/random controls. Measure extra inference/serialization cost and final coder gain. The baseline update order must expose the signal before the predicted bit.
audit_entries.combination_work: Discussed as a way to reuse already computed information; no recorded trained multi-signal model. Its dependency is native feature collection, not necessarily a full replacement transformer.

audit_entries.title: Sorted dictionaries and reversible 2D/aligned symbolic organization — rounds 1, 4, 5
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Sorting/storage probes and several word-code groupings; no optimized alignment transform with complete reconstruction metadata. E1, E3, E4, E8.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Round-1 sorted forms lost; round-4 prefix/suffix/distributional groupings improved toy neural loss; round-5 dictionary front-coding grew. These test different objects. A genuine aligned-text codec must preserve occurrence order, row/column placement, exact spelling and exceptions, then train its predictor on that representation. Compare total streams/model cost, not dictionary bytes alone.
audit_entries.combination_work: Word grouping plus letter embeddings was implemented. The broader spatial/alignment transform plus matched neural decoder was not. Do not merge their conclusions.

audit_entries.title: Wordle/progressive feedback, multiple proposals and feedback alphabets — rounds 1, 3
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Feedback costs, decoder determinism and reversible-refinement mathematics were addressed; equal-model-call comparisons were useful. E2, E7.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Reported 3/5/9-call Wordle schemes lost 4–20% against parallel character decoding with the same calls. Small early PCC screens also lost. Define full feedback alphabets, rejection/termination and residual probabilities; train on the exact reachable refinement states and optimize a registered proposal policy. Compare richer feedback, binary locks and rank coding at matched CPU/model cost. The single-byte identity explains no inherent advantage, not universal practical failure.
audit_entries.combination_work: Feedback versus direct reveal and skeleton variants were compared. The article retrieval + shared heads + masked decoder proposed in the file was not implemented as a jointly trained system.

audit_entries.title: Confidence-ordered any-order/bidirectional decoding — rounds 1, 3
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Deterministic position selection and matched decoded-state training were studied. The search over schedules/architectures was limited. E2, E7.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: At 2,500 steps, L2R 1.703 versus block4 2.099, block16 2.450, block64 3.922 bpb. Small own-training-text models also favored L2R. Test optimized schedule entropy/ties, actual reachable state distribution, causal masks for what is decoded, positional design, blockwise caching and multiple paired training budgets. Demonstrate convergence of the comparison rather than assume it from 20 passes. Full right-context information must be paid first.
audit_entries.combination_work: Blocks, skeletons, adaptation and warm starts were explored. No mature bidirectional model with article memory, shared heads and production decoding kernels is evidenced.

audit_entries.title: Structure/skeleton first, article/block hierarchy and shared heads — rounds 1, 3
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Classical and neural skeleton splits were tested. The full hierarchy/shared-network proposal remained only partly represented. E2, E7.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Classical skeleton costs 1.942–2.000 versus 1.864; stronger skeleton 1.905. Letters became 9.7% cheaper while spaces became 51% more expensive. A fair architecture test jointly optimizes structure, positions, capitalization, markup, residuals and a shared conditional decoder. Measure all streams under M3; compare separately trained heads versus shared heads and charge schedule/state cost.
audit_entries.combination_work: Skeleton + masked prediction/adaptation was tried. Article-level state plus paid structure and retrieval was proposed, not realized. These failed skeleton choices do not exhaust hierarchical factorization.

audit_entries.title: Word length first with separate/shared structural heads — round 3
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Two seeds, explicit length/punctuation/letter costs and classical-blend comparisons constitute a useful focused study. E2, E7.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Mean neural improvement about 0.77%; final weak-classical blend worsened about 0.20%. The length model saw roughly 15% fewer training bytes. Match raw-text exposure and exact length/case/escape cost, compare shared-head versus independent structure parameters, then evaluate a real final coder. A standalone neural gain is insufficient.
audit_entries.combination_work: Length + classical blend was tested. The proposed length + scratch + TTL + length-aware CM combination was not run, although the report recommended it.

audit_entries.title: Whole-word proposals, candidate-rank coding and spelling fallback
audit_entries.rigor_applied: A plausible rank/escape factorization was specified. No direct mature candidate-rank codec result is recoverable. E7, E18.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Two-token dictionary groups and later word-tree experts are related, not equivalent. Specify a deterministic prefix-derived ranked candidate set, normalized rank/escape probabilities, exact spelling/case fallback and candidate-search cost. Compare direct word softmax/tree coding, ranked proposals and iterative refinement using the same word features. Misses and selector bits count.
audit_entries.combination_work: Conceptual morphology/retrieval/rank/fallback pipeline exists; no measured end-to-end combination. It should not inherit Wordle's negative result without its own test.

audit_entries.title: Train on decoder-reachable states; autoregressive warm start
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Round 3 explicitly addressed train/decode mismatch, which is valuable. Optimization depth remained bounded. E2, E7.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Decoded-state matching improved a losing family from 2.633 to 2.485 bpb. Warm-start plus 1,000 steps remained worse than the L2R control. Test on-policy decoded-state sampling, schedule curricula, joint structure/content objectives and equal useful-target/compute controls; ensure warm-start position/mask distribution and optimization are compatible. One failed warm start does not exclude pretrained adaptation.
audit_entries.combination_work: Matched states were combined with skeleton/any-order models. No longer, multi-seed, jointly tuned retrieval/skeleton training followed.

audit_entries.title: Hard-word specialists and targeting cumulative residual cost
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Early reports identified rare names, first letters and long-distance repeats; round 7 used actual final-bit attribution. That diagnostic rigor improved substantially. E1, E3, E9.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Round 1 reports roughly 1% specialist gain on a weak base. Later atlases show frequent known words can dominate aggregate bits. Rank total final-coded cost, not rare types or striking examples. Train a causal specialist with a confidence gate and all misses, compare generic capacity, and check whether named difficult categories retain gain after the final mixer. Diagnostic target labels cannot become inference features.
audit_entries.combination_work: Diagnostics informed cache and word-model proposals. A residual-cost-trained full lexical specialist has not been executed.

audit_entries.title: Capacity per stored byte: float, Q4, Q3 and ternary networks — rounds 1–2
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Matched data/steps and a capacity/storage table; actual exported file/coder/CPU comparison is missing. Early halfway quantization was especially weak. E1.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Round 2 reports 6.3M Q4 1.516 bpb, 8.5M Q3 1.537, 14.9M ternary 1.477, 14.9M float 1.393. “Equal size” used nominal budgets, while entropy estimates differ. Train matched rate–distortion frontiers, export every asset, benchmark real ternary sparse/add kernels and compare complete package at eligible CPU time. Parameter multiplication is not free.
audit_entries.combination_work: Ternary + online adaptation + weak CM was tested. Optimized ternary kernels and later production-core retraining were not completed.

audit_entries.title: Exact weight entropy coding and conditional tensor codecs — rounds 2, 5, 7
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Strongest on the exact older-FX2 round-7 component: all tensors, independent loaders and native probability/archive identity. Initial generic entropy proposals were only estimates. E1, E4, E11.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Round 5's simple row/column contexts mostly lost; generic round-7 alternatives were at best 289 bytes larger. Reproducing the published C5 tensor/histogram/column codec saved 28,200 bytes/copy; added packed loader 768/copy leaves 54,864 bytes for two copies. Actual lexical C3 grows 940/copy. Preserve checkpoint-specific results; complete production packaging/PGO remains necessary. Credit the published codec rather than call its reproduction a new architecture breakthrough.
audit_entries.combination_work: Exact packing was combined with BF16 variants and a loader-size screen. Its savings cannot be added to an incompatible lexical checkpoint.

audit_entries.title: Longer windows, sparse long-range attention and match-fed context — rounds 2–3
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Residual-distance atlas and a 2,048-context run; no broad attention/caching design study. E1, E2.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Rare repeats 512–2,048 bytes back improved 15.4→10.3 bits; overall 1.509 versus 1.483 bpb worsened with changed training circumstances. Match useful exposure and optimizer, then compare larger window, sparse long-range links, recurrent summaries and match-model inputs under equal inference cost. Optimize masks and positional encoding for the extended context.
audit_entries.combination_work: Longer-context observations motivated TTL/cache studies. Sparse attention and a trained match-fed transformer remained proposals, not completed alternatives.

audit_entries.title: Full-network decoder-side online adaptation — rounds 2–4
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Decoder-reproducible updates after observed windows and several learning rates; exact CPU/export trajectory remains unverified. E1, E3.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Float 1.483→1.463, ternary 1.477→1.436 with lr 1e−5; larger rates hurt. Later dictionary adaptation stacked with caches. Implement native update order, starting quantized weights, optimizer state/precision and rescaling identically; price backward passes and storage/RAM. Compare learning schedules at fixed CPU rather than assume the GPU gain qualifies.
audit_entries.combination_work: This is a genuine combined line of inquiry with CM, caches and kNN. It was not optimized into a measured CPU-constrained submission.

audit_entries.title: Selective adaptation: output head, norms, last MLP/layers — rounds 2, 5
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Actual production-related head and deeper adaptation code; selective choices were limited. E4, E13.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Head improves neural loss 0.63% but native archive only 194,669→194,626 bytes. Head + last MLP improves neural loss 0.77% with about 10% added CPU. Test causal gradients and low-rank/norm subsets at equal update time, and assess complete final-coder costs on multiple warm strata. “cmix already does this” is an interpretation of these arms, not a theorem about adaptation.
audit_entries.combination_work: Added to the existing coder; not jointly optimized with learned lexical residuals or a changed base model. Production time headroom can reasonably limit further investment.

audit_entries.title: Fast article deltas, two-timescale adaptation and reset policies — round 5
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Implemented variations on a slow delta, but a narrow schedule/state search. E4, E13.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Fast and two-timescale variants reportedly worsened. Specify reset/momentum/carry rules and compare equal update work, regularized fast state, slow shared state and meta-learned initialization. Use held-prefix updates and candidate's own mixer state. A losing untrained fast branch does not disprove a trained adaptation policy.
audit_entries.combination_work: Adaptation timescales were combined experimentally. No architecture-level meta-training or learned article controller is recorded.

audit_entries.title: Neural adaptation plus classical context mixing — rounds 2–4
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Actual factorial-style comparisons show overlap and stacking; early CM is explicitly weak. E1, E3.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Ternary frozen 1.477, adapted 1.436, adapted + CM 1.405; frozen + CM 1.421. These are useful toy results. Repeat with equal stored/model cost and an actual strong final coder, including neutral integration and CPU. Decompose whether adaptation supplies information not already recovered by the stronger mix.
audit_entries.combination_work: Yes, this combination was implemented and measured. That evidence is much stronger than a claim that every later proposal received the same treatment.

audit_entries.title: Carry transformer state across article boundaries — round 5
audit_entries.rigor_applied: A frozen state-carry intervention, not a model trained for the new boundary semantics. E4.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Reported +11.8% / +1.2% loss on two slices without finetuning. Train a matched carry/reset model, inspect state stability, and compare summaries/retrieval with the same boundary information. Preserve actual causal order and document piece resets. The negative test supports rejecting that frozen intervention; it does not reject learned cross-article memory.
audit_entries.combination_work: Limited to state carry within the existing pipeline. A trained cross-article architecture plus lexical gating was not executed.

audit_entries.title: Empty/register scratch slots — round 3
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Explicit empty versus memory-content controls were a good design decision. Short single-run rankings remain uncertain. E2.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Plain 1.7439, 128 empty 1.6981, 256 empty 1.7235 bpb after 2,500 steps. Compare equal parameter/compute models, multiple paired seeds, different register placement and longer training; measure whether added capacity or architecture explains the gain. Price registers' parameters and operations.
audit_entries.combination_work: Scratch + keep-alive memory was actually built. Register count and content-model design were not brought to an optimized long-training frontier.

audit_entries.title: Learned context TTL / reuse selection — rounds 3, 7
audit_entries.rigor_applied: A logistic reuse scorer on 5.3M examples and several memory choices; future-dependent global-frequency/link assumptions were acknowledged. E2, E16.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Scorer uses age/title/count/frequency; stored words selected by reuse probability × estimated savings / bytes. 128 keep-alive model scores 1.7206 versus its blanked 1.7400. That is not a directly trained gain/hazard optimizer. Fit prefix-visible survival and future **final-bit** benefit, exclude optimistic future statistics, use same-capacity independent controls, and train the exported selector jointly. M8 is essential.
audit_entries.combination_work: Tested with scratch and weak CM. Round-7 fixed TTL16/128 probes did not implement the learned selection or context-dependent survival proposed later.

audit_entries.title: Encoder searches helpful context and transmits keep/drop choices — round 3
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Paid selector analysis correctly exposed a large cost for per-candidate choices. The searched coding family was narrow. E2.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Reported oracle choice costs 10.1% for all candidates, 4.1% top 100, 2.1% top 30, 1.0% top 10. Compare block/article-level amortized selectors, shared priors, structured choices and null mode with actual payload savings. A transmitted selector helping many targets is different from individual keep/drop flags. Do not reject all paid context based on this family.
audit_entries.combination_work: Selector cost was analyzed relative to TTL's budget, not incorporated into a learned complete compressor. Later article latents revisit the broader hypothesis.

audit_entries.title: Linked-article memory and tiny learned knowledge representations — rounds 3, 7
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Link-memory ablation and explanation of reconstructible history versus stored facts. No mature semantic/knowledge architecture. E2, E7, E18.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Linked-article memory 1.7142 versus blanked 1.7150, with optimistic indexing conditions. Define only already decoded articles as donors, count index/selector model, compare title/link identity, random donors and summary capacity. Learned facts in weights must pay actual bytes; an external knowledge database cannot be assumed available.
audit_entries.combination_work: A link-memory model was trained; broader retrieval + progressive decoding + tiny fact representation stayed conceptual.

audit_entries.title: Scratch + learned keep-alive memory + length-aware coding — round 3
audit_entries.rigor_applied: The scratch/TTL pair has actual model ablations; the larger proposed combination is incomplete. E2.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: 128 empty + 128 keep-alive scores 1.7012, versus its blanked half 1.7289; weak-classical blend 1.5518. Same-trained-model blanking is useful but not an independently optimized no-memory control. Run a paired factorial design for scratch, TTL, word length and matched CM, with longer exposure and seeds. Charge full package and CPU.
audit_entries.combination_work: Pairing scratch and TTL was substantive. Adding word length and a length-aware classical model was recommended but not executed; do not describe the entire four-part stack as tested.

audit_entries.title: Frequency, anagram, prefix, suffix and distributional word-code groups — round 4
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Five explicit layouts with the same word-model architecture/steps; actual code and results survive. Useful representation research, short of mature production optimization. E3, E12.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Toy bpb: frequency 1.4624; anagram 1.4367; alphabetical 1.4283; suffix 1.4231; distributional 1.3974. Dictionary sizes vary 150–237 KB. Match raw-byte exposure, contexts, actual entropy-packed assets and seeds; test hierarchical/shared morphology alternatives against the strongest production WRT. Code adjacency can help finite models without being intrinsically a shorter word code.
audit_entries.combination_work: Grouping + letter embeddings + miners + token CM was genuinely developed. This positive evidence should not be dismissed because later fixed neighbor boosts fail.

audit_entries.title: Start-position, end-position and bag-of-letter embeddings — round 4
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Explicit compositional embeddings and two layout comparisons. No isolated equal-capacity random or learned generic-feature control reported. E3, E12.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Alphabetical 1.4283→1.4069 (1.5%); distributional 1.3974→1.3823 (1.1%). Test each component, tied/untied embeddings, order-sensitive n-grams and same-parameter learned projections at matched exposure. Price embedding tensors and dictionary metadata. Gains establish a promising trained inductive bias in the toy models, not a production percentage.
audit_entries.combination_work: Yes, actual integration with dictionary models and subsequent miners. Optimal basis/rank, quantization and later associative use remain unresolved.

audit_entries.title: Token-level classical CM and mixer topology/initialization — round 4
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Iterative implementation work addressed a concrete failure. This is among the better engineered combination studies. E3, E12.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Token CM 1.7365 versus byte 1.8245. Initial neural/CM mix 1.2573 worsened the neural 1.2430; changing bias and 12,288→960 weight contexts improved mixing. Compare neutral topology, trained mix and same context budgets on confirmation pieces, then actual range coding/CPU. Seven mixer choices on the test articles introduce selection bias into the final score.
audit_entries.combination_work: Implemented with neural cache/adaptation/kNN and ensembles. Its iteration shows real engineering, but there is no eligible native package evaluation of that final stack.

audit_entries.title: Hidden-state cache over already decoded current text — rounds 4, 6
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Strict earlier-position masks, normalized continuation distributions and causal confidence buckets in source. Later real-coder screens corrected an accumulator bug. E3, E5, E12.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Byte model 1.4829→1.4242; dictionary cache also helped. Round-6 final-coder cache only about 0.045%/0.084% after correction. Implement bounded integer/compressed keys and an actual native query path, test same work random/exact controls, and measure warm RAM and eligible CPU. Dense 16K×192 comparisons per byte are not a demonstrated practical search kernel.
audit_entries.combination_work: Extensively stacked with adaptation/kNN/CM. Compression of the cache and joint learning of retrieval/gates were not developed to a prize-feasible frontier.

audit_entries.title: Cross-article kNN over decoder-reconstructed hidden states — round 4
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Causal prior training articles, GPU blocked exact retrieval and several datastore sizes; CPU/RAM qualification absent. E3, E12.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Larger banks improve toy loss; recorded bank reaches 25,792,942 half vectors. This exceeds 10 GB for vectors alone at width288. Test bounded reservoir/article summaries, product/int8 codes, approximate search recall and total CPU/RAM on a native decoder. Preserve availability offsets and price index work; GPU blocked search is not eligible inference.
audit_entries.combination_work: Substantial integration and bank-size scaling, including shared retrieval across snapshots. No engineered resource-feasible replacement bank was measured.

audit_entries.title: Dictionary + algebra + adaptation + cache + kNN + CM — round 4
audit_entries.rigor_applied: A real multi-component system with intermediate ablations, not merely a proposed combination. Baseline fairness and actual score constraints remained incomplete. E3, E12.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Matched 18K byte model 1.3752 versus combined 1.2117; byte-cache control 1.325 narrows the relative gain. Later banks/training improve further. Compare useful exposure, parameter/package cost, retrieval availability and CPU at equal budgets. Run all component removals in a matched strong baseline and a complete eligible codec before projecting to enwik9.
audit_entries.combination_work: This is the clearest “yes, experimentally combined” case. It still does not document hours of thought per idea or global architecture optimization.

audit_entries.title: Snapshot ensembles, linear/geometric mixtures and shared searches — round 4
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Multiple snapshot combinations, probability normalization and online bucket selection are implemented. Cost and repeated test selection are not fully priced. E3, E12.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Two/three/four models reach 1.1871/1.1841/1.1824 bpb; shared retrieval slightly worse at 1.1854 than member-specific 1.1841. Measure every stored snapshot, lookup, forward pass and native CPU. Compare compressed deltas, distillation and equal-capacity single models; freeze selection before fresh evaluation. The four-model 20.27% toy gain is not a record comparison.
audit_entries.combination_work: Real diversity and search-sharing experiments occurred. A low-cost distilled joint model and final complete package were not built.

audit_entries.title: Train/overfit the exact corpus; model description versus payload — rounds 3–4
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Own-training-text arena and 100 MB scoring recognized the correct fixed-corpus objective. Stored-size accounting remained a proxy. E2, E3, E12.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Round 4 reports 10-pass byte 18.98 MB and dictionary/cache 18.54 MB using entropy-size estimates and one copy. Build actual quantized containers, include every required copy and code, and independently decode. Corpus-specific training is allowed, but a memorized table/latent must be stored and charged. Evaluate net rate–distortion at the full corpus, not held-out percentage alone.
audit_entries.combination_work: Overfit models were combined with miners; the strongest full stack was scored only on test articles, not encoded as a whole submission.

audit_entries.title: Port fxcm_v26 lexical contexts into the FX2 transformer pipeline — round 5
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Actual classical-model source integration preserving transformer priors and two native-related comparisons. Resource measurement was noisy. E4.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Reported slice archives 194,183→193,404 and 428,199→427,132 (0.40%/0.25%). Measure full warm total, matched compiled flags, CPU/RAM and mixer state. It adds roughly 11–15% runtime in those estimates and is already part of the lexical comparator; it cannot count as a new gain on that comparator.
audit_entries.combination_work: Integrated with the existing neural coder and proposed tail/storage changes. Their joint full package was not measured.

audit_entries.title: Timestamp-first revision records and revision-ID residual transform — round 5
audit_entries.rigor_applied: C++/Python byte agreement, whole preprocessing round trips and preserved split line count are strong transform engineering. Model matching was incomplete. E4, E13.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: On 100K records, neural + cmix 810,234→763,359; roughly 114 KB whole-region projection. Reordered metadata changes the model's trained stream. Test a matched retrained/finetuned conditional model, exact reversal and full final package; compare the stream-preserving timestamp expert under the same production baseline.
audit_entries.combination_work: Combined with title-copy transformation for exact inversion. The projected compression sum was not a full joint neural/package result.

audit_entries.title: Interlanguage owner-title copy transform — round 5
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Owner alignment, eight genuine empty-title escapes and 244,173 replacements were handled, with exact transform round trips. E4, E13.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: 30K-block cmix-only 736,486→698,705; around76 KB extrapolation without transformer. Measure neural final coder on all transformed blocks and the actual lexical layout; keep exact escapes/case/ordering. Compare stream-preserving copy experts to avoid the changed-stream training mismatch.
audit_entries.combination_work: Exact inversion combined with the revision transform. Its compression interaction with changed neural data remained a projection.

audit_entries.title: Store selected float parameters as BF16 — round 5
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Actual container and native decoding work, plus loss checks. This is a lossy model-numeric change, not automatically exact storage. E4, E11.

audit_entries.title: Learned persistent signed activation, injection, rejection and survival
audit_entries.rigor_applied: This central idea has equations and subsequent corrections, **not an implemented trained mechanism**. E6, E10, E23.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Fixed echo/TTL is an incomplete proxy for a_t(v)=λ_t(v)a_{t−1}(v)+I_t(u,v,H_t). Train signed relation, context gate and survival jointly, with bounded memory, exact exported arithmetic and all false associations charged. Surprise may be used only after its source word completes. Compare exact memory, structural/learned memory and equal generic capacity; test first mentions separately from repeats without using future labels as inputs.
audit_entries.combination_work: There is thoughtful written synthesis with placement/residual heads. No end-to-end trained activation × syntax × memory architecture, or hours-per-idea log, supports calling it deeply experimentally optimized.

audit_entries.title: Counterfactual edge savings, hazard, optimal activation and eviction
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Corrected horizon-versus-next-event mismatch and interacting-edge attribution. These are meaningful theoretical improvements, not empirical calibration. E6, E10, E16.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: No learned counterfactual deletion or hazard model was executed; exponential TTL is not that test. Define immediate state deletion versus full replay, sample paired interventions on prefix-generated edges, estimate next-step hazards and train joint normalized likelihood/rate. Eviction uses expected future final-bit value from available features, never actual future reuse. Edge-wise savings cannot simply be summed.
audit_entries.combination_work: Combined conceptually with sparse activations and MDL, not with trained controllers or native causal counterfactual evaluation.

audit_entries.title: Multi-source/multi-channel log-odds accumulation and activation×placement interaction
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Equations include signed evidence and an interaction term; correlated evidence/double counting was recognized. E6, E10.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Fixed expert mixtures do not train β_AP a(v)p(v), contextual cross-channel coefficients or suppression. Run factorial removal of channels and interaction terms in the same jointly trained residual, match storage/CPU, clip exported activations and score every outcome. A neutral branch bounds losses only under its precise mixture semantics, not by wishful convergence of coefficients.
audit_entries.combination_work: This is the defining proposed combination; it remains design only. Its failure cannot be inferred from additive fixed unigram probes.

audit_entries.title: Shared residual transformer/controllers and multiple specialized heads
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Probability-space correction and parameter-sharing equations are valid proposals; no trained shared syntax/algebra/article/memory residual in round 7. E6, E18, E23.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: The128-factor calibration is not this model, and four independent snapshots are a different architecture. Train shared state with small heads, compare one generic residual versus specialized heads at equal rate/time, measure sequential corrections' final normalizer and exported size. Register rank/state/model byte caps and test literal/control fallback. Avoid making failed simpler screening a universal prerequisite.
audit_entries.combination_work: Written design integrates several ideas; implementation, learned interaction ablations and architecture tuning are absent. This is one of the largest gaps relative to the user's requested research depth.

audit_entries.title: Independent learned residual against the native final-bit coder
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Later design identifies a way around the unrelated core-GPU parity dependency. Integer calibration infrastructure is verified; the contextual residual is untrained. E22, E23.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Collect native causal features and y,p16; train q=Q16 σ(logit(p)+rθ(c)) with complete loss plus actual model/code rate. Keep baseline internal updates unchanged, so teacher-forced baseline trajectories remain valid. Compare32/128 KiB-budget contextual models with generic/identity controls, then fresh native decode/package/CPU. Core parity is not required for this independent head; its own export parity is.
audit_entries.combination_work: Proposed to combine syntax, spelling, memory and paid latent. No new model from this proposal has been launched or measured.

audit_entries.title: Constructors, content variables and rare constants: reversible split
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Exact lexical distinction, framing, literal-word handling, raw reconstruction and native-bit budget were analyzed. Grammar-class semantics remain a heuristic lexicon, not validated POS tags. E24.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Declared176 constructors carry about 17.1997% of sampled bits;56 generic-codec comparisons all grew. Test lexicon/learned-class alternatives with all tags/model assets charged, exact punctuation/case/markup and content order. Separately optimize C,A,G streams under M3. If only that measured constructor bucket changes, it cannot alone explain a20% total gain; its full-corpus share is unverified.
audit_entries.combination_work: Exact split and layout variants were implemented. A jointly trained content/grammar model was not, so the constructor hypothesis is only partly tested.

audit_entries.title: Constructor sets, multisets and permutation coding
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Explicitly corrected loss of order/multiplicity; exact packet decoding includes order. E24.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Multiset-plus-order framed layout grows about 19.473% zlib9 /22.204% LZMA6. Most gaps (87.345%) contain0/1 constructors, limiting set amortization in these samples. Test enumerative permutation coding conditioned on already paid anchors, adaptive set priors and exact repeats at equal framing; evaluate total streams rather than assume equal sets are equal sentences.
audit_entries.combination_work: Set identity + order + literal frames was tested. Learned contextual permutation or subset selection was not trained.

audit_entries.title: Ordered constructor templates, shared word dictionaries and subset grammars
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Actual table/layout variants, charged IDs and raw round trips. Broad subset/compositional grammar model is still unimplemented. E24.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Ordered framed templates grow18.847%/21.493%; best one-byte skeleton marker + constructor-word table grows2.066%/4.601%. Low reuse of larger gaps argues against these static tables. Train conditional ordered gaps or a reusable grammar with paid derivations, compare direct adaptive gap model, and measure native complete cost. A generic LZMA loss is not a learned grammar loss.
audit_entries.combination_work: Dictionary sharing, markers and gaps were combined iteratively. Content-conditioned neural prediction and learned subset composition were not.

audit_entries.title: Content first, then grammar with both left/right content; neural infilling
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Valid chain-rule factorization, paid right context and exact alignment requirements are developed. The actual learned codec is design only. E7, E24, E23.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Skeleton packets and small earlier masked models are partial proxies. Train Q_C(C), Q_A(A|C), Q_G(G|C,A) on their actual decode order, compare left-only/right-only/both anchors and equal total model/compute budgets, then reconstruct exact bytes. Stripped text scored by the old frozen transformer is out of distribution and cannot settle the architecture. “There _ a camel” does not remove the need to code is/was and surrounding layout.
audit_entries.combination_work: Rigorous written combined architecture exists. No joint content-first model or optimized conditional infiller was run.

audit_entries.title: Prefix-only constructor-run and syntax expert on unchanged stream
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Causal completed-word updates and full-bit normalized residual scoring; limited hand-built state. E21, E24.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Final batch uses constructor-run length/class and prior content rank, with 176-word list and neutral controls. No material gain. Test a learned ordered-run/trie model conditioned on decoded content/punctuation, compare same-sized generic syntax state and morphology, and measure actual integer native coder. An observed gap's future length or next noun must not activate its own gate.
audit_entries.combination_work: Combined with the fixed syntax/memory suite. No trained constructor × content × residual interaction.

audit_entries.title: Representative finetuning/full retraining with correct MDL rate
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Detailed later contracts address useful-token weighting, optimizer, numerical export and actual rate. Those contracts have not been executed. E20.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Round 6 short λ30 is the actual training evidence; round 7 core finetuning was not run. Require frozen F0 identity, baseline-preserving representative F1 λ0, then matched small-rate arms, actual packed export/final coder and appropriate seeds/pieces. Restore original optimizer if available; otherwise warm-start conservatively and do not change all factors at once. Full scratch retraining is an alternative, not proven necessary.
audit_entries.combination_work: Payload/rate/data/export/CPU dependencies are planned in detail. Learned architecture + rate-aware continuation has not been tested. The $70 stages are caps, not completed spending.

audit_entries.title: Residual-importance sampling and mixer-aware training objectives
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Importance correction and limitations of a simplified neural/CM surrogate are stated. Design only. E20.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: No residual-importance/mixer-aware training arm is recorded. Fix π_t=η/T+(1−η)c_t/Σc and use1/(Tπ_t) if preserving uniform likelihood; record whether reweighting is intentional. Compare uniform and corrected sampling at equal useful targets, validate surrogate sensitivity against the actual nonlinear mixer, and select by final payload plus exported size. Expensive examples may be training labels, not future inference inputs.
audit_entries.combination_work: Intended to combine difficult-word diagnostics with MDL continuation. No measured joint outcome or optimal allocation of gradient effort exists.

audit_entries.title: Small adapters, merged LoRA, larger teacher and distillation
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Correctly prices merged versus unmerged updates and teacher/student costs; no executed round 7 training study. E18, E20.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: 8M/10M structural loads passed, but neural parity failed and inference comparisons were skipped. For core teachers fix parity first; for an independent residual train its own control. Compare merged quantized adapters, separately stored adapters and distilled equal-cost student using actual containers and CPU. “LoRA is small” does not make changed base weights or forward passes free.
audit_entries.combination_work: Proposed with rate-aware finetuning and shared lexical heads. No trained teacher→student or adapter × memory experiment supports a compression estimate.

audit_entries.title: Native/GPU parity, checkpoint reconstruction and lexical configuration
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Strict load/shape audits, macro correction and actual pointwise diagnostics; failure preserved. These are prerequisite engineering tasks, not compression gains. E10, E15, E20.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Correct C3 macros/codebooks enable native round trips; larger checkpoints load structurally. Compatible FX2 GPU pilot fails ordinary-row parity despite matching reset fallbacks. Locate first layer/state divergence, check prior/activation quantization, attention/KDA piece resets and export, then lexical F0. Do not silently relax gates or assume loading proves functional equivalence. Independent residual training needs only its own faithful native interface.
audit_entries.combination_work: This infrastructure supports all core-training variants. Its unresolved state was allowed to delay too many independent architectures; dependency redesign is required.

audit_entries.title: Training-prior compression, cached native embeddings and data throughput
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Exact sample prior-storage round trips and full old-transform inverse; cached-embedding equivalence remains a hypothesis. E21, E25.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: 48 storage probes cover107,479,040 bytes; raw zstd9 best fast sample50,901,611 bytes, not guaranteed full ratio. Full old-FX2 inverse reconstructs1 B exact; production lexical data/full priors remain unregenerated. Test streaming decode/read amplification and useful targets/dollar; if caching prior embeddings, prove fixed preprocessing and no other raw-prior use. Storage savings facilitate training; they are not archive gains.
audit_entries.combination_work: Data compression and recovery were executed to support training. Prior-embedding caching plus a complete trained model/export has not been tested.

audit_entries.title: Warm full-history, complete package and eligible CPU/RAM validation
audit_entries.rigor_applied: Many mini/native round trips and source/input hashes; no new full qualifying compressor package. E5, E21, E22, E25.
audit_entries.actual_testing_and_needed_testing: Four2M lexical-checkpoint/native traces and fresh64K calibration E/F, plus1 B preprocessing inverse. A/B/C/D are cold pieces of the old FX2 transformed stream, not a full production lexical order. Build actual production data/package, run separate complete comp/decomp, verify1 B output hash and count all assets/options. Measure both calibrated CPU runs and peak warm RAM/disk; short-piece RSS and linear runtime projections do not qualify it.
audit_entries.combination_work: Individual components reached substantial correctness evidence. Their full matched joint package, mature memory history and source-to-submission integration remain incomplete. No 20% result or absolute optimum is established.
